_about: Quest Forge client profile. Read by tools/lite-client/apply-profile.ps1 on Windows and by the Mac's Prism tooling. Keys that start with _ are comments. Every setting is client-side video, HUD or audio: the server never sees any of it, so the world, mobs, items, recipes and quests are identical by construction. 'why' gives one line per setting: what it buys, and what it costs in looks. Section keys: options_txt (vanilla options.txt, key:value), angelica_options (merged into config/angelica-options.json), angelica_modules (config/angelica-modules.cfg, Forge B:/I:/S:/D: keys), shaders (config/shaders.properties + shaderpacks/<pack>.txt), optifine (the OptiFine E7 fallback client only), mods_aside (jar-name prefixes moved out of mods/), jvm (Prism memory by installed RAM).
title: Full: the normal pack
hardware: Gaming PC from the last ~5 years: RTX 3060 / RX 6600 class or better, 6+ cores, 16 GB+, 1920x1080 or 2560x1440

why.options_txt.renderDistance: 8 chunks in singleplayer. On the friends' server the server only sends 6, so 8 draws nothing extra past the fog; lite's 6 is free there.
why.options_txt.fancyGraphics: Fancy: translucent leaves, fancy rain, entity blob shadows. The normal look.
why.options_txt.ao: Smooth lighting Maximum. Under Celeritas, Minimum and Maximum render the same; the value matters only on the E7 fallback.
why.options_txt.particles: All particles. Lycanites and TragicMC fights are particle storms; this is the full show.
why.options_txt.mipmapLevels: 4 mip levels: no shimmer on distant blocks. Costs about 33% more texture memory and a per-tick re-mip of animated textures.
why.options_txt.anisotropicFiltering: Vanilla key, 1 = off. Angelica filters through texture_filter_mode instead; left at the pack's value so the E7 fallback is unchanged.
why.options_txt.maxFps: 120 instead of the pack's 260 (unlimited): nothing visible on a 60/120 Hz monitor, far less GPU heat in menus and caves. Raise it to match a 144 or 240 Hz monitor.
why.options_txt.enableVsync: Off. Angelica paces frames through vsync_mode; this stays off so the two never fight.
why.options_txt.clouds: Clouds on. With the QuestForge shader pack the pack draws its own sky and clouds; with shaders off these are Angelica's cheap VBO clouds.
why.options_txt.fboEnable: Framebuffer objects on; required by every shader loader. Never off.
why.options_txt.advancedOpengl: Vanilla occlusion queries, off. Angelica has its own culling; the key is inert and kept false so nothing re-enables it on E7.
why.angelica_options.quality.biome_blend_rad: 3 blocks of biome colour blending, FANCY mode: soft grass and water borders between biomes. Costs chunk-build time on the worker threads, not on the render thread.
why.angelica_options.quality.grass_quality: DEFAULT follows Fancy: grass blocks get the side overlay texture. Looks: the normal grass block.
why.angelica_options.quality.use_celeritas_s: Celeritas's own smooth lighting on: soft corner shading in every chunk.
why.angelica_options.quality.texture_filter_: RGSS plus anisotropic: four rotated texture samples and hardware AF, the sharpest distant floors and the least shimmer. Four times the texture samples of plain filtering; fine on a discrete GPU.
why.angelica_options.quality.texel_sampling: LINEAR: Angelica's default texel sampling. NEAREST gives a harder pixel look; a taste choice, not a cost.
why.angelica_options.advanced.vsync_mode: OFF: frames are not paced to the monitor (the maxFps cap does that job without the input lag). Angelica's default would follow the monitor. Measured: with it on every frame pins to 4.16 ms.
why.angelica_options.performance: Celeritas's culling and deferral switches, all on: these are its defaults and cost nothing in looks. Listed so a profile puts them back if someone toggled them off.
why.angelica_options.reducer.enabled: Off: the game runs at full rate when unfocused or idle. Lite and potato turn it on.
why.angelica_modules.B:enableDynamicLights: Held torches, blazes and fiery Lycanites light the blocks around them. Every move re-renders the chunks around the light; the normal pack keeps it.
why.angelica_modules.I:droppedItemLimit: Angelica draws at most 256 dropped items; its default.
why.angelica_modules.B:showSplashMemoryBar: Angelica's loading-screen memory bar off: it would draw over the Quest Forge mural. Same in every profile.
why.shaders: The pack's own shader pack, QuestForge, at QF_PRESET 2 (Medium): sun shadows to 80 blocks with entities, TAA, SSR, GTAO, 4-tap soft shadows. Medium is the pack default and the RTX 3060 at 1080p target. High (3) is for an RTX 3060-class card at 1440p; Ultra (4) is the dev PC. Pick those on the shader screen (F8). if_missing 'keep': when the QuestForge pack is not installed, the current shader choice is left alone.
why.optifine: OptiFine E7 fallback client only (GPUs without OpenGL 3.3). Smooth FPS off: it called glFinish every frame. Fast Render off: it breaks every shader pack on E7.
why.mods_aside: Nothing moved aside: every client-only mod stays.
why.jvm: The whole pack lives in about 1.3 GB of live heap (measured). Past 5-6 GB a bigger heap only adds RAM pressure; on 8 GB never above 3 GB or Windows swaps and the game stutters. Angelica adds about 95 MB. The two -Dfml.ignore* flags are required by the E7 client's patched Forge jar and harmless on Angelica's stock Forge 1614.
